text:
sam: Heads-up  I put together a compact pilot gating doc for Optimize toolkit (batching + prefix-cache + quant recs + eval alerts). Need quick buy-in on acceptance numbers and who actually signs the gate.

maria: Short read looks good. Can we inline the minimal acceptance thresholds so SRE can run the smoke tests without chasing us?

sam: Yep. Proposed acceptance (MVP pilot):
- perf: p50 < 130ms, p95 < 320ms, p99 < 700ms for 8k context on pilot pool
- reliability: error rate < 0.5% over 1h window
- cache: steady-state hit_ratio >= 70% under representative workload
- cost: tail quant/batch config should not increase per-token cost > 10% vs baseline
- eval: golden_set.mean_f1 within -3% of baseline over 1h rolling window

cheng: I can run perf+load. Will add microbench scripts and a smoke harness. Need to know exact golden_set file. Priya, can you drop it in /optimize/golden/ ?

priya: Dropping golden_set v1 (200 prompts) in S3 now. We'll include baseline_f1 numbers and examples of failure categories.

jules: For tenant control we need a runtime opt-out: `quant=on|off|auto`. Will spec the API header and Console toggle. Product wants a short note: "recommended" profiles and risk callouts.

noah: From infra: memory pressure is our main concern with prefix-cache. Request a hard limit per worker and an eviction strategy doc. Also need mem-leak test plan (12h churn + sustained QPS).

sam: Noted. Acceptance criterion for mem: no OOMs in 12h run and 95th mem usage < 85% of limit. Eviction policy: lru by prefix_age with tombstone GC every 6h.

priya: Draft alert rule for regressions (MVP will page humans, no auto-rollback):
```yaml
alert: optimize_golden_regression
expr: (golden_set_mean_f1 / baseline_f1) < 0.97
for: 60m
labels:
  severity: critical
annotations:
  summary: "Optimize pilot golden set F1 dropped >3%"
  runbook: "/runbooks/optimize/pilot-eval.md"
```

sam: Canary plan: 0.5% traffic -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Minimum observation windows: 6h / 12h / 24h. Stop conditions: any alert fires OR p99 > 2x baseline OR error rate > 1% for the window.

maria: Who signs the gate at each step? Propose: eng-sre approves canary -> product approves 25% -> infra & security approve 100%. Agree?

cheng: Agree. I'll own SLO verification and dashboard tiles. Will instrument: `opt.batch.latency.{p50,p95,p99}`, `opt.cache.hit_ratio`, `opt.quant.fallbacks`, `opt.eval.golden_f1`.

jules: UI asks: surface per-tenant quant status + quick link to opt-out. I'll add that to the Console mock and include copy for onboarding.

eng-oncall-bot: deploy-bot: preview build (#1078) passed unit tests. scheduled jobs: cache-stress, quant-fallback, golden-eval.

sam: Action list: 1) priya uploads golden_set + baseline numbers; 2) cheng to land perf harness + dashboards; 3) noah to publish mem limits + eviction doc; 4) jules to spec tenant API header + Console mock; 5) sam to PR pilot gate doc with acceptance matrix.

maria: Quick note: capture customer asks in a simple spreadsheet (tenant, ask, priority). We'll triage for v1 vs v2.

sam: Nice. Let's reconvene after smoke tests finish. Planning 9:30 sync tomorrow. :calendar:
